out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knives stored in between tables, between refrigeration units; observed bowls used as scoops to dispense dry goods, TCS foods.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed in use utensils.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee wash hands without soap.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC instructed employee on proper hand washing techniques. PIC instructed employee on proper hand washing techniques.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee sneeze into gloved hands and attempt to engage in food preparation.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS conducted education regarding proper hand washing with PIC. PIC instructed employee on proper hand washing.

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed walk in cooler out of temperature at 42-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. PIC contacted repair technician during inspection.

violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. FOLLOW-UP will be conducted in 10 days.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Grease Trap, Location for Easy Access
violations.observation: The grease trap has been installed in a manner preventing easy access for cleaning of the grease trap. Dish machine drain board inhibits the ability to easily access grease trap.
violations.corrective_action: If used, a grease trap shall be located to be easily accessible for cleaning. PIC will provide verification of grease trap access during follow-up inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use in mop bucket with bristles submerged.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. PIC placed mop to be air dried.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls, ceilings, and floor junctures in the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. FOLLOW-UP inspection will be conducted in 10 days.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles above WIC are not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. FOLLOW-UP will be conducted in 10 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS OBSERVED NO HAND SOAP AT THE HAND SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw meat (beef and chicken) stored over cooked food and produce in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC HAD THE EMPLOYEES REORGANIZE THE WALK IN COOLER TO PUT ALL RAW FOOD UNDER READY TO EAT FOOD.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice (59F), cut cabbage (54F), bean sprouts (56F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC RELOCATED THE FOOD TO THE WALK IN COOLER

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: beef thawing in standing water in the 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC MOVED THE BEEF TO THE WALK IN COOLER

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. PIC COULD NOT PROVIDE A FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC WILL PROVIDE EVIDENCE OF THE PURCHASE OF A FOOD THERMOMETER WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS ON A SHELF IN THE KITCHEN AND OBSERVED 1 LIVE MOUSE IN THE KITCHEN BY THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC WILL CLEAN THE FLOOR AROUND EQUIPMENT, OUTSIDE OF EQUIPMENT AND WALLS. PIC WILL THEN RECEIVE PEST CONTROL SERVICES WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the outside of equipment and the shelves inside the refrigerators in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: observed dirty slicer on the counter in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EMPLOYEE CLEANED THE SLICER.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and the floor around equipment are need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
